html:
SMTO-AUT-0037 — SMTO doesn't recognize the Google access that was requested

GUID: 16add038-a5b2-5c61-8690-96193c8fdef5
Slug: google-feature-invalid
Domain: AUT · Subsystem: google-workspace

What happened

  • The request named a Google feature SMTO doesn't support, so SMTO didn't create a sign-in link or add any access. SMTO only grants Google access from its own fixed list of features.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to connect Google again and say plainly what you need, such as reading your calendar, sending email or working with Drive files. SMTO then picks the matching access from its own supported list, so nothing is misspelled.
  2. If the feature list was typed by hand, use only names from SMTO's list, spelled exactly. The Manual page 'Shared Google Workspace identity' lists them all. Names must match exactly, so a typo or a Google web address in the list is refused.

What success looks like

  • SMTO gives you a Google sign-in link that lists the features you asked for.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the exact wording of your request, to the person who manages SMTO's Google setup. Don't try to add Google permissions another way; SMTO only accepts its listed features.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Google feature selection was rejected because it was not a list made only of supported Google Workspace feature IDs from auth/google/scopes.py FEATURES.

What this means

  • Feature selection is not a bounded list of supported Google Workspace feature IDs. Authorization establishes a particular connection, account and scope. It neither expands operation permissions nor proves the outcome of a request already dispatched.

Why this can happen

  • Feature selection is not a bounded list of supported Google Workspace feature IDs.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare each selected feature with the advertised Google feature list and list bound.

How to fix it

  • Pass features as a list of IDs from agent_runtime.auth.google.scopes.FEATURES (for example gmail_read, calendar_read, drive_file) to auth.google_connect, auth.google_status or POST /api/agent/google/auth/start. Raw OAuth scope URLs and unknown names are rejected and are never expanded into scopes.
  • Choose supported feature IDs from auth.google_connect; arbitrary scope requests are not accepted.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm account identity and required features before retrying.

How to verify the fix

  • The selected feature IDs validate and derive only their documented scopes.

What not to do

  • Do not expose client secrets, tokens, codes or PKCE verifiers.
  • Do not switch accounts or repeat uncertain mutations automatically.

Technical notes

  • Authorization establishes a particular connection, account and scope. It neither expands operation permissions nor proves the outcome of a request already dispatched.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
